(b) Verification of the General Characteristics of IPMS.
The purpose of this test is to verify the access to management mimics from consoles and to verify the IPMS’s response time.
Supervision has been started. The PLCs are in RUN mode. The test is performed at the PEC console. The OO1 mimic is displayed on left screen and BC mimic on right screen
Verify that the access to other domains is possible only in Monitoring Mode .
• Click on AUXILIARY tab and then GF system. • Verify that the GF mimic the access to control buttons.
• List of systems is displayed and then GF mimic is displayed. • Control buttons is ‘Inhibited’.
• Click on STABILITY tab and then DM system. • Verify that the DM mimic the access to control buttons.
• List of systems is displayed and then DM mimic is displayed. • Control buttons is ‘Inhibited’.
Supervision has been started. The PLCs are in RUN mode.The test is performed on PEC. The installation is on standby, the local/remote changeover switch for DG1 preheating pump is on remote mode

• Verify on the BD1 mimic with preheating pump on remote. • Put the changeover switch to local and observe on BD1 mimic the symbol of preheating pump. • The time taken < 2 sec when black frame appears.
• No black frame around the preheating pump symbol. • The preheating pump has black frame around it.

Supervision has been started. The PLCs are in RUN mode. The test is performed on DSC. The installation is on standby, the local/remote changeover switch for the cruise pump is on remote. The local/remote change over switch for the cruise pump is on remote
• Verify on the DT mimic with preheating pump on remote. • Put the changeover switch to local and observe on DT mimic the symbol of preheating pump. • The time taken < 2 sec when black frame appears.
• No black frame around the cruise pump symbol. • The cruise pump has black frame around it.
